# CasaGuía

> CasaGuía is an offline Welcome Book Builder for holiday rental hosts: fill one form and get a print-ready guest welcome book in English, Spanish, German and French, plus Wi-Fi QR cards and house rules, check-out and recycling signs. Sold on Etsy (shop KitWiseStudios). Not affiliated with Airbnb, Booking.com or VRBO.

## Pages
- [CasaGuía: holiday rental welcome book in 4 languages (EN, ES, DE, FR)](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/casaguia/): Offline welcome book builder for Airbnb, Booking.com and VRBO hosts: one form, a print-ready guest book in English, Spanish, German and French, Wi-Fi QR cards and house signs.
- [What to include in a vacation rental welcome book (checklist)](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/casaguia/what-to-include-in-a-welcome-book.html): A complete checklist for a holiday rental guest welcome book: arrival, Wi-Fi, house rules, appliances, recycling, emergencies, local tips and check-out.
- [Holiday rental house rules in English, Spanish, German and French (free text)](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/casaguia/house-rules-4-languages.html): Free, ready-to-copy house rules for Airbnb and holiday rentals in English, Spanish, German and French: check-in, smoking, parties, quiet hours, recycling and emergencies.
- [Libro de bienvenida para piso turístico en varios idiomas: qué incluir](https://kitwisestudio.github.io/casaguia/libro-de-bienvenida-piso-turistico.html): Qué debe tener el libro de bienvenida de un piso turístico y cómo hacerlo en español, inglés, alemán y francés a la vez.
